foreign body/path, different verb and missing/malformed key refuse before checkpoint for all13 operations
one pending operation refuses another and same-key different-body replay
same-key exact replay clears prior settlement before its checkpoint
unsigned actor, unavailable journal and failed durable checkpoint cannot admit a dispatch
only current park catalogue and exact supported control reads are allowlisted
audit reads are scoped to exact actor, owned fixture, action and start time
exact active seeded actor, operator, branch and preferences are mandatory
public fonts require exact provider/resource/query and no credentials
nonpositive, server, in-flight, refused and invalid success responses never confirm
each create confirms one stable identity and counts it once across exact replay
edit/archive and import acknowledgements require their precise success shapes
workbook commit requires exact token, filename, bytes and current park
cold start refuses existing journals/results/images and journal exists before browser auth
native auth and workbook export/preview remain exact bounded dispatches
recovery reuses exact key/body and restoration requires all latest attempts plus full baseline

limitations: Pure operation/read/response functions and static dispatch/recovery/cold-start pins only; no browser, authentication, staging execution or private journal access.
Native controls and geometry are reviewed separately; these results are not staging acceptance.
